events.verdict: Jokic (DEN) establishes a legal picking position and does not deliver contact to Caldwell-Pope (LAL).
As Jokic (DEN) is cutting through the lane, he and Caldwell-Pope (LAL) briefly engage, and then immediately disengage.
Davis (LAL) maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt by Murray (DEN).
Caldwell-Pope (LAL) and Jokic (DEN) briefly engage and disengage as the two are attempting to retrieve the rebound.
Barton (DEN) dislodges Caruso (LAL) from his position during the rebound.
Davis's (LAL) forearm connects with Harris's (DEN) neck/head.

As Jokic (DEN) backs down, Davis (LAL) has his hand to his hip before correcting. He does not affect his SQBR. He then jumps vertical legally to defend Jokic's shot attempt near the rim. Davis has his left foot down when Jokic makes contact with it.
Jokic (DEN) and Davis (LAL) come together. Davis extends his arm somewhat, but Jokic's reaction is not commensurate with the level of contact.
As Harris (DEN) swipes down in an attempt to dislodge the ball from Davis (LAL) during the shot attempt near the rim, he does not make contact with Davis' arm.
Jokic (DEN) makes marginal contact with Davis (LAL) during the shot attempt near the rim.
Davis (LAL) maintains a legal guarding position on Murray (DEN) on the end of the drive.
Caruso (LAL) maintains a legal guarding position during the jump shot attempt by Barton (DEN).
Caruso (LAL) does not establish a legal picking position as he continues to move up the floor not allowing Murray (DEN) to avoid the pick to defend the shot.
Jokic (DEN) establishes a legal picking position and does not deliver contact to Caldwell-Pope (LAL) as Caldwell-Pope moves into Jokic.

Davis (LAL) moves legally alongside of Murray (DEN) as when Murray begins to gather the ball to attempt his shot near the rim, Murray moves back into Davis initiating the contact. As Murray rises and begins his shot attempt, Davis remains legal as he jumps alongside of Murray and as Davis swipes down in an attempt to block the shot, he does not make contact with Murray's arm.
Millsap (DEN) commits a take foul on Davis (LAL).
As Green (LAL) legally defends the jump shot attempt by avoiding Millsap (DEN) and jumping to the side, Millsap extends his leg out in an unnatural way tripping Green.
Barton (DEN) commits a take foul on James (LAL).
